title: Stevie Wonder’s ‘Songs in the Key of Life’ 50th Anniversary Tour: Here’s Where to Buy Tickets For U.S. Show Online
summary: The music legend goes on the road to celebrate the album's 50th anniversary release starting in New York City on Thursday, Nov. 19.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Stevie Wonder is gearing up for a six-date U.S. tour to celebrate the 50th anniversary of his seminal album, Songs in the Key of Life — which was first released in September 1976. After an overseas run, the anniversary tour ‘s U.S. portion is slated to kick off at Madison Square Garden in New York City on Nov. 19, before winding down at Intuit Dome in Los Angeles on Dec. 19.

Shop Stevie Wonder Tour Tickets At TicketMaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Wonder tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Stevie Wonder 2026 Tour Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Stevie Wonder Tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets in 2026.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. Additionally, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit, or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, ticket prices were starting at $209.

EARN REWARDS

Find Stevie Wonder Tickets at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front of section or the VIP section, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly-rated sellers.” With Vivid Seats, your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your concert, or your money back.

PROMO CODES

Find Stevie Wonder Tickets at SeatGeek

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap Stevie Wonder tickets online from $213. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

PROMO CODE

Find Stevie Wonder Tickets at TicketNetwork

Don’t forget TicketNetwork . The retailer has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to the Wonder tour with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $203, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

SEATING OPTIONS

Find Stevie Wonder Tickets at Gametime

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts, such as Wonder’s, start at $156. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket-buying experience.
